predictions.rationale: Provides UML-specific notation for Node Instances, the primary visual element on deployment diagrams, indicating direct support for rendering this feature.
Generic notation provider for node instances; forms the base logic that the UML-specific class refines, central to displaying nodes on deployment diagrams.
Handles UML notation of Component Instances which are mapped onto nodes in deployment diagrams, directly influencing how components appear on the diagram.
Base notation class for component instances; essential for drawing software artifacts that are deployed on hardware nodes.
Critic checks for component instances lacking hosting nodes—a deployment-specific consistency rule, indicating intimate knowledge of deployment diagram semantics.
Another critic aimed at detecting components not assigned to nodes; supports correctness of deployment diagrams.
Ensures component instances are properly typed; while broader than deployment, it directly applies to elements shown on deployment diagrams.
Explorer navigation rule that links nodes to resident components, mirroring the node-component mapping depicted in deployment diagrams.
Provides tree navigation from any diagram object to contained nodes, enabling browsing and management of nodes created in deployment diagrams.
Explorer rule exposing nodes from the model root, facilitating selection and editing of deployment-relevant elements.
